ship_trophy_room.quest_intro_inheritance: Isa Leicester was recovered from a cryopod as an infant, swaddled in a spacer suit bearing the name Isaac Leicester. The Shattered Ring has returned the preserved suit to her, and she has taken it to her old workshop for study.
ship_trophy_room.quest_intro_revealed: Isa Leicester was recovered from a cryopod as an infant, swaddled in a spacer suit bearing the name Isaac Leicester. A concealed identification wafer in the suit recovered Isaac Thomas Leicester's first personal log and linked him to both surviving Coronal Hypershunts.
ship_trophy_room.quest_summary_complete: Five scattered records reconstructed Isaac Thomas Leicester's logs. Isa recovered the final entry from Gan Eden's Space Elevator after Cherubim and Lahat Haharev were destroyed—though ordinary Omega Shards and Facets have since begun appearing among some Remnant Ordos.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_inheritance: Investigate Isa's inherited spacer suit in her old workshop at the Shattered Ring.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_hypershunts: Search the Coronal Hypershunts for clues about Isaac Leicester.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_gan_eden: Travel through Power Transit Gate - Gan Eden and find Isaac Leicester.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_bosses: Defeat Cherubim and Lahat Haharev, the golden Omega Shards sealing the Space Elevator.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_elevator: Search the Gan Eden Space Elevator and find Isaac Leicester.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_complete: Isa's search for Isaac Leicester is complete.
ship_trophy_room.quest_objective_home: Bring Isa home to the Shattered Ring.

ship_trophy_room.dmod_vendor_intro_one: The Ring's nanoforge engineer works out of a hullbreaking cradle overlooking the wreck-farms. The gantries around it are equally suited to careful restoration and carefully planned damage.
ship_trophy_room.dmod_vendor_intro_two: "Most yards promise to take the scars out," the engineer says. "I can put exactly the right scar back in. You name the ship and the compromise."
ship_trophy_room.dmod_vendor_intro_three: This service installs one eligible D-mod of your choice. A ship may not exceed the normal limit of %s D-mods.

ship_trophy_room.masterwork_intro: "I have an idea. Or... a dream, more like," Isa says. "Get me an Onslaught XIV. A Paragon. An Invictus. A Conquest. An Executor. Do that, and I can get to work."
ship_trophy_room.masterwork_progress: "We're getting there," Isa says. "The Hall network has %s of the five hulls. I still need %s."
ship_trophy_room.masterwork_complete_unseen: All five hulls are displayed. Isa has completed Awe.
ship_trophy_room.masterwork_complete_seen: All five required hulls are currently displayed.
ship_trophy_room.tritachyon_ad_intro:
Before Isa can answer, her slate vibrates again.

This time, the advertisement addresses her by name.
ship_trophy_room.tritachyon_ad_assessment: Based on her recent technical searches, professional history, fleet composition, estimated liquidity, and observed pupil response during the demonstration, Tri-Tachyon predicts an eighty-seven percent likelihood that Isa would benefit from immediate Afflictor ownership.
ship_trophy_room.trios_intro:
Isa hastily wipes the advert from her slate.

"I didn't give them any of that information."

The showroom voice answers without being asked, speaking in the polished cadence of a TriOS delta-level AI.
ship_trophy_room.trios_reply: "You didn't need to, Ms. Leicester. Tri-Tachyon Marketing Services is the finest in the Domain. We have--"
ship_trophy_room.trios_cutoff: Isa cuts it off with a wave, scowling at the speakers overhead.
